findings.title: Current visible source has drifted beyond the 50-language catalog
findings.evidence: 247 unique visible source strings are uncataloged across 15 of 25 canonical routes; /tokenomics contributes 63.
findings.impact: Localized URLs can publish localized SEO identity and partial UI while leaving substantive English prose visible.
findings.remediation: Re-extract the current rendered route inventory, translate with protected protocol terms, review natively, and repeat the 50-locale browser matrix.

findings.title: Native-language review is incomplete
findings.evidence: Automated catalog structure and rendering passed, but no native reviewer approved all 49 non-English locale payloads.
findings.impact: Meaning, cadence, idiom, and culturally appropriate wording are not independently assured.
findings.remediation: Record locale-by-locale native review, corrections, reviewer role, source digest, and UTC review time.

findings.title: Development and build dependency graph retains transitive advisories
findings.evidence: Production audit reports zero vulnerabilities; the complete graph reports 15 moderate and 7 high advisories in build/dev and Solana tooling chains.
findings.impact: These packages are not represented as shipped production dependencies, but they remain a release-engineering and local-tooling exposure.
findings.remediation: Track upstream compatible releases and upgrade through tested dependency changes; do not apply npm's proposed breaking force-downgrades.

findings.title: Physical and native-OS browser coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: Android and iOS are emulated; no physical iPhone/Android, native Linux host, or native macOS Safari host was tested.
findings.impact: Device-specific font, viewport, GPU, media, and browser chrome behavior remains outside this evidence.
findings.remediation: Run a source-bound smoke matrix on representative physical devices and native Linux/macOS hosts.

findings.title: Tokenomics client toggle overwrote localized document language
findings.evidence: The legacy EN/TR effect wrote lang=en on /ur/tokenomics and other localized tokenomics routes.
findings.remediation: Localized route ownership now prevents the legacy toggle from mutating document language.

findings.title: Predictive mechanics labels failed targeted contrast
findings.evidence: Axe confirmed color-contrast failures for the mechanics eyebrow and number labels across Firefox, WebKit, and iOS emulation.
findings.remediation: Light-surface labels now use #981019 and pass the repeated matrix.

findings.title: Locale readiness could report true before translation settlement
findings.evidence: The server emitted data-locale-ready=true before the client locale payload applied, allowing a premature test observation.
findings.remediation: Non-English documents now begin false and turn true only after catalog activation.

findings.title: Locale prompt timeout text failed targeted contrast on iOS emulation
findings.evidence: Axe reported .locale-prompt small below the targeted contrast rule.
findings.remediation: Foreground opacity increased from 0.42 to 0.72 and passes the rerun.

findings.title: Fresh CI checkouts omitted generated locale payloads
findings.evidence: Both hosted web jobs at 921bf02 returned /i18n payload 404s because Playwright started Vinext directly while public/i18n is intentionally generated and git-ignored; the runtime then exposed an English fallback as ready.
findings.remediation: Playwright now runs compile:i18n before starting Vinext, payload failures remain localeReady=false with an explicit localeError marker, and browser diagnostics preserve exact HTTP and non-media request failures while ignoring engine-specific cancellation of MP4 streams. The complete local matrix passes at 762cdf4b7d44e43878187c9103b4a5c7f226667e; final hosted rerun is pending.
